title: LiPol Battery Co., Ltd. LP402030 200mAh 3.7V with PCM specification and drawing (1 page, drawing FD_2030_40, orig. 28.06.2021)
supports: identity: 'Lithium Polymer Battery Pack LP402030 200mAh 3.7V with Protection Circuit Module (PCM)', manufactured by LiPol Battery Co., Ltd - China; drawing FD_2030_40, sheet 3, orig. 28.06.2021
Mechanical Characteristics: cell LP402030; PCM yes; NTC no; configuration 1S1P; weight appr. 4.0 g

Electrical Specification: rated capacity 200 mAh min, 200 mAh typ; nominal voltage 3.7 V; watt-hour rating 0.74 Wh; max. operating voltage range 2.75 V to 4.20 V; max. charge voltage 4.2 V +-50 mV; max. charge current 100 mA; max. continuous discharge current 200 mA; discharge cut off 2.75 V; internal impedance <500 mOhm; expected cycle life 500 cycles >= 80 % @ (0.5C/0.5C) @ 23+-5 C

Cell Protection: overcharge detection 4.275 +-50 mV (0.7 to 1.3 s delay, release 4.275 V +-50 mV); overdischarge detection 2.75 V +-50 mV (14 to 26 ms delay, resume 2.50 V +-50 mV); overcurrent detection 1 A to 2.5 A (8 to 16 ms delay)
Ambient Conditions: charge 0 to +45 C; discharge -20 to +60 C; storage 1 year at -20 to +30 C >70 %, 3 months at -20 to +45 C >70 %, 1 month at -20 to +60 C >70 %; humidity 65 +-20 %RH
Environmental and Safety: meets the Battery Directives; battery parts IEC 62133 and RoHS compliant
